function.name: establish_webhook
function.description: Establish a new webhook subscription in Asana. This endpoint creates a webhook that listens for events on a specific resource and delivers the events to the specified target URL. A confirmation handshake is required during the creation process to verify the webhook. Security: OAuth 2.0 (Bearer token required). Required scope: webhooks:write.

resource.description: The GID of the resource to subscribe to for webhook events. (Required)

target.description: The target URL where webhook events will be sent. (Required)

opt_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. For example: ['active', 'target', 'resource', 'workspace'].

opt_pretty.description: If true, returns prettified JSON output for easier readability.

resource_type.description: The type of the resource which created the event when modified (e.g. 'task').

resource_subtype.description: The subtype of the resource for event filtering (e.g. 'milestone').

action.description: The type of change on the resource to pass through the filter (e.g. 'changed').

fields.description: A whitelist of fields for events which will pass the filter when the resource is changed. This field is valid only when action is 'changed'.

filters.description: A list of filters to apply to the events for this webhook.

function.name: update_webhook
function.description: Update an existing webhook in Asana. Supports updating the webhook’s filters and optional field expansion. Security: OAuth2 Bearer token required. Required scope: webhooks:write.

webhook_gid.description: The GID of the webhook to update. (Required)

filters.description: Array of filter objects to overwrite the webhook’s filters.

opt_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.

opt_pretty.description: If true, returns prettified output for debugging (increased response size).

function.name: delete_webhook
function.description: Delete an existing webhook in Asana. This permanently removes the webhook and stops it from receiving events. Security: OAuth2 Bearer token required. Required scope: webhooks:write.
